# Kush Dental Clinic

> Kush Dental Clinic is a premier dental practice specializing in gentle, pain-free dentistry, digital smile design, and 3D diagnostics.

## Pages
- [Home](http://localhost:5173/): Comprehensive dental care, modern 3D diagnostics, treatment showcases, and patient stories.
- [Services](http://localhost:5173/services): All dental treatments including preventive dentistry, cosmetic smile design, dental implants, Invisalign, and autologous PRF biological healing.
- [About Us](http://localhost:5173/about): Our clinical team, modern treatment suites, and gentle care philosophy.
- [Journal](http://localhost:5173/blog): Oral health guides, treatment comparisons, and smile makeover insights.
- [Book Appointment](http://localhost:5173/book): Schedule your private dental consultation.

## Key Services
- Digital Smile Design & Veneers
- Pain-Free Anesthesia & Sedation
- 3D CBCT Imaging & Guided Implantology
- Biological PRF Healing & Regeneration
- Invisalign Clear Orthodontics
- Restorative & Preventive Family Dentistry
